title: Deprecated cls kwarg forwarded to http.parse_cookie
detail: The `parse_cookie` function in sansio accepts `**kwargs` and forwards them to `http.parse_cookie`. The core `http.parse_cookie` does not accept a `cls` keyword, so if a caller passes `cls`, a TypeError will be raised. This breaks the deprecation path and can cause runtime failures.

title: Incorrect return type for sansio.parse_cookie
detail: The original sansio implementation returned an `ImmutableMultiDict` (or a subclass) based on the `cls` kwarg. After delegating to `http.parse_cookie`, the `cls` kwarg is ignored and a plain dict is returned. This breaks callers such as `werkzeug.sansio.request.Request.cookies`, which expect an `ImmutableMultiDict` and may rely on its methods.
